title: Handshake, entropy and TLS authority
summary: WebSocket protocol code does not own cryptographic entropy or TLS credentials. Handshake nonce/accept calculation and frame-mask generation are injected authorities; TLS remains owned by the selected socket provider/security profile.
invariants: WebSocketHandshakeCrypto is the injected authority for client nonce and Sec-WebSocket-Accept calculation.
WebSocketMaskSource is the injected authority for fresh four-byte client mask keys.
Production entropy is not bundled or claimed by dev1.
TLS certificate, trust and private-key material must not move into WebSocket objects.
wss composition uses the common TLS/socket authority; WebSocket does not acquire OpenSSL or TLS sockets directly.
The RFC 6455 example key/accept vector is qualification evidence, not a production randomness mechanism.
